description:
The committed web production dependency graph is advisory-free while preserving the built UI.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=info exits zero in web/ against the committed package-lock.json with no audit exception.
- [hard] REQ-02: Web lint, unit tests, TypeScript build, and production bundle succeed after the dependency changes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Any dependency API or rendering migration updates every affected UI consumer and regression test in the same change.

## Notes

Blast radius: `web/package.json`, `web/package-lock.json`, and affected `web/src/` code/tests; no Rust or MCP contract changes.
title: Remediate web production dependency advisories
